summary: The team is in execution mode on two fronts: locking down a messy Outlook credential issue while pushing the Asia Star and Intelligent China programs to the front of the global marketing queue, with the Knowledge website redesign and 2027 SEO/SEM planning close behind.
summaryDetail: The most immediate fire is the Outlook account lockout caused by stale credentials across devices—everyone needs to delete and re-login on all devices, update the home Outlook client, and confirm the backend unlock with JSB before it disrupts communications. On the strategy side, the 30 June prioritization stands: Asia Star and Intelligent China are the top two programs for China visibility, with Berkeley a possible third, and Joseph owes the target-areas/prompts document plus the Asia Star participant/CRM hot-lead analysis that will shape the Google Ads audit. The Knowledge website redesign is mid-flight—the team settled on keeping the two-menu structure, folding BCI/BSI indices into the Knowledge section, and using Joseph's editorial mockup as inspiration rather than a blueprint, so Joseph needs to share the HTML and lock a 30-minute feedback session with Julie and the team lead before Joker makes changes. This week also needs the Google Ads conversion-tracking brief so the audit can start, and the Intelligent China webpage finalized and traffic driven to it. Looking ahead, the 2027 Website SEO/GEO/SEM and third-party costs proposal needs an early-week discussion among Ira, Joseph and the team, and logistics for the 27 November Cartier Women's Initiative 20th-anniversary roundtable at the Beijing campus are ramping up alongside the Women in Leadership Forum emcee script review.

decisions.text: Use the new password across all devices and update credentials to prevent re-locking.
Remove the dedicated videos section; videos will be dispersed by topic across the site.
Keep the two-menu structure (Knowledge menu and School menu) at the top.
Bring BCI and BSI indices into the Knowledge section, similar to the school homepage banner.
Do not add a stock-market ticker at the very top of the homepage.
Use Joseph's mockup as inspiration rather than following it exactly, combining ideas with the current version.
Prioritize Asia Star and Intelligent China as the top two programs for promotion.
